headline: Japan Services Sector PMI Shows Growth for Fifth Consecutive Month
summary: Japan's services sector continued to expand in October, marking the fifth straight month of growth according to the latest PMI data.
why: The services PMI is a critical gauge of domestic economic health in Japan, reflecting consumer demand and business activity in the tertiary sector.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Consistent growth in the services sector suggests resilient domestic economic activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Positive economic data often strengthens investor sentiment regarding the country's growth outlook and potential central bank policy adjustments.
